title: Performance Improvement Acknowledgment Form
subtitle: Use this acknowledgment to prove what was presented, preserve questions or disagreement, route exceptions, and confirm accountable receipt for a performance improvement workflow.
description: An original operational performance improvement acknowledgment form that controls a objective performance-support and review record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the manager, employee, or HR case owner needs a traceable acknowledgment so the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer can start, revise, extend, complete, close, or escalate the performance-improvement process under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Performance Improvement acknowledgment identity and context
sections.guidance: Identify the record, participant, presenter, source decision, and exact acknowledgment event.

sections.title: Performance Improvement information and responsibilities presented
sections.guidance: Record what was actually explained; do not use a signature as a substitute for delivery.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement acknowledgment topics
items: Specific expectation, standard, and job-related reason were explained
Examples include dates, outputs, effects, and source records rather than labels
Employee response, disagreement, context, and supporting evidence were recorded
Targets, measurement method, resources, checkpoints, and due dates were restated
Accommodation request or medical information is routed confidentially outside this record
Retaliation, complaint, leave, and protected-activity concerns receive independent review
Acknowledgment confirms receipt and discussion, not agreement or waiver
Question, correction, appeal, and additional-evidence routes were provided

blocks.label: Material, policy, decision, or instruction presented
Key terms, responsibilities, conditions, limitations, and changes from prior understanding

sections.title: Performance Improvement understanding, questions, and clarification
sections.guidance: Give the participant a route to identify uncertainty, disagreement, access needs, or missing information.

blocks.label: Question, response, source, unresolved point, and owner
Understanding and access checks
items: Participant had a meaningful opportunity to review the information
Terms were presented in a usable language and accessible format
Dates, amounts, schedules, duties, and conditions were restated accurately
Participant could ask questions without pressure or retaliation
Unanswered questions have an owner and response due point
Disagreement is preserved without changing the fact of receipt
No waiver, consent, or admission is inferred beyond the stated acknowledgment
Correction and additional-evidence routes were provided

blocks.label: Participant statement, disagreement, requested correction, additional evidence, and desired follow-up

fields.label: Participant response in their own words

sections.title: Performance Improvement exception, privacy, and escalation routing
sections.guidance: Protect restricted information and preserve any concern requiring qualified review.

blocks.label: Acknowledgment stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement exception and escalation triggers
items: Record contains medical details or confidential accommodation information
Employee reports retaliation, discrimination, harassment, coercion, or interference
Expectation or measure changed without notice during the review period
Required coaching, tools, access, workload decision, or feedback was not provided
Manager evidence is inaccurate, altered, incomplete, or attributed to the wrong employee
Comparable-employee or prior-treatment information indicates inconsistent application
Decision was communicated or implemented before required HR review
Threat, violence, self-harm, safety, or emergency concern requires immediate qualified routing

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Performance Improvement receipt status and resulting action
sections.guidance: Record the limited meaning of acknowledgment and route every follow-up.

blocks.label: Meaning of acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: A signature or recorded receipt confirms presentation and opportunity to respond. It does not by itself prove agreement, waive a right, admit fault, or replace review under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements.

blocks.label: Clarification, correction, delivery, and follow-up actions

sections.title: Performance Improvement acknowledgment handoff and closeout
sections.guidance: Confirm the record and every unresolved clarification reached the correct owner.

blocks.label: Open performance improvement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance

fields.label: Qualified Hr, Employee-Relations, Legal, Or Management Reviewer / date
